experiments.name: both-block-seed2026
experiments.purpose: Final image block and final text block adapted together; matched full report. Isolates whether unfreezing text adds anything to image semantics over image-only adaptation at the same seed.

experiments.name: both-block-seed2027
experiments.purpose: Same arm, second matched seed; budgeted up front rather than triggered by a positive first seed

experiments.name: both-block-seed2028
experiments.purpose: Same arm, third matched seed; budgeted up front rather than triggered by a positive first seed

selection_policy: mean_r@1 descending, validation_loss ascending, earliest epoch

primary_comparator.rationale: The working question is whether the IMAGE tower reads medical semantics better. Unadapted DINOv2 is the anchor, not the contrast: both-block versus unadapted confounds two simultaneous changes. Image-block at the same seed is the single-factor comparator, so the only difference is whether the final text block was also unfrozen.

learning_rate_policy: --lr-image 1e-5 is copied by value from the image-block arm and --lr-text 2e-5 from the text-block arm, so each tower is adapted at the same rate as the single-factor arm it is compared against. Neither was tuned here.
repeat_rule: None. All three matched seeds are frozen here up front, so no positive-gain trigger decides whether more run. This follows the text-block precedent and deliberately abandons the image-block arm's conditional-repeat rule.
